title: emc2 map object
description: An object on the map, as held by the object store and sent to clients. '$defs/content' is the part a change request carries; id, version and meta are added by the object store. Data model 1.9.0 (PDA), see model/README.md.

content.description: The fields of a map object that its creator controls.

type.description: Object type. Core types: core.symbol (single-point APP-6 symbol), core.multipoint (APP-6 tactical graphic defined by control points), core.shape (geometry drawn with a style), and from data model 1.6.0 core.text (a text at a point, with text). Plugins may define '<plugin-id>.<name>' types, but should prefer core types plus an extension so that every plugin can show the object.

dataType.description: What kind of information the object is (ADR-0023), e.g. core.general or cot-in.cot: one of the data types ECore lists from the plugins' manifests (model rule 14). Not the same as type, which says what the object is on the map.

displayClass.description: Data model 1.6.0 (CR-0041 part D; T-182, owner Q58 A): what the object is for the user's display filters, from a fixed list; the map view hides it while the user's switch for the class is off. Absent: no class. Editors forward it.

fieldSets.description: Data model 1.4.0 (ADR-0050, CR-0030 part 3): the field sets the object carries, by their full ids '<plugin-id>.<set>', each once. Empty means absent (rule 13). On update an absent list keeps the stored one and a listed set is added; nothing removes a set (rule 5's third exception). A set that a request adds must be declared by a loaded plugin (rule 18). The fields' values stay in extensions.<plugin-id>.<name>.

relations.description: Data model 1.4.0 (ADR-0051, CR-0031): the object's relations to other objects, each a kind and the other object's id, each entry once, at most 1 024. Empty means absent (rule 13). Replaced as a whole on update, as the core fields are (rule 5). Each kind is checked as rule 17 says; the other object is never checked (it may not exist, or be in another layer or workspace), and a delete never cascades.

text.description: Data model 1.6.0 (CR-0041 part A; ADR-0055 point 4): the text of a core.text object, centred on its Point. Its colour is style.strokeColor, else the map view's label colour.

value.description: 1 to 1 024 characters; a line break starts a new line.

rotation.description: Degrees clockwise from true north at the point; absent means 0.

relation.description: Data model 1.4.0 (ADR-0051 point 1): one relation, e.g. a GMTI sensor's pairing with a track it detected.

kind.description: A kind a loaded plugin declares in its manifest's relationKinds, '<plugin-id>.<name>' (rule 17).

time.description: Time attributes of the information (model rule 15), e.g. from CoT's time, start and stale. All optional; what happens after the expiry is configured per data type (ADR-0023).

observed.description: When the information was observed or reported by its source.

validFrom.description: From when the information is valid. Not after expires.

symbol.description: A symbol: APP-6, or (data model 1.4.0, ADR-0047) emc2's own vessel symbol. Rendered by the symbology plugin.

sidc.description: Symbol identification code. Its form depends on the standard (see below).
APP-6D: 20 digits. The version (digits 1-2) is 10, 11 or 12.
APP-6E: 30 digits; 20 digits mean the 30-digit code with digits 21-30 all zero (writers write the 20-digit form then). The version (digits 1-2) is 13 or 14.

Data model 1.4.0, vessel (ADR-0047, CR-0030 part 3b): 4 digits: APP-6D's context (0 reality, 1 exercise, 2 simulation), APP-6D's standard identity (0 pending to 6 hostile), then the AIS ship and cargo type 00 to 99 (ITU-R M.1371; 00 not available). E.g. 0470, a real neutral cargo ship.

modifiers.description: Amplifiers of a symbol, named as in milsymbol's options (camelCase). A closed list: adding a name is a minor model change. direction, speed, distances and azimuths are machine values; all others are text as displayed. Data model 1.4.0 (CR-0030 part 2, ADR-0043 point 9) adds the amplifiers that tactical graphics (core.multipoint) use beyond milsymbol's names: distances (AM), azimuths (AN), targetNumber (AP), uniqueDesignation1 (T1), uniqueDesignation2 (T2) and dtg1 (W1), as in mil-sym-ts's amplifier table for the APP-6 D and E graphics. Single-point symbols ignore them.

azimuths.description: Data model 1.4.0, amplifier AN of tactical graphics: azimuths in degrees clockwise from true north, 0 to 360, in the order the graphic defines (e.g. a sector range fan's left and right limits, ring by ring). Machine values; the symbology plugin formats them.

direction.description: Direction of movement: degrees clockwise from true north. Drawn as an arrow.

distances.description: Data model 1.4.0, amplifier AM of tactical graphics: distances in metres, 0 to 20 000 000, in the order the graphic defines (e.g. a circle's radius, a range fan's ranges, a corridor's width). Machine values; the symbology plugin formats them.

dtg1.description: Data model 1.4.0, amplifier W1 of tactical graphics: the second date-time group (e.g. the end of a period), as displayed.

location.description: Location as displayed. The real position is the geometry.

speed.description: Speed over ground in metres per second. The symbology plugin formats it for display.

targetNumber.description: Data model 1.4.0, amplifier AP of tactical graphics: a target number, as displayed.

uniqueDesignation1.description: Data model 1.4.0, amplifier T1 of tactical graphics: the second unique designation (e.g. a boundary's unit on the other side).

uniqueDesignation2.description: Data model 1.4.0, amplifier T2 of tactical graphics (APP-6 E): the third unique designation.

style.description: How a core.shape (or a symbol's outline, where supported) is drawn.

fillPattern.description: Data model 1.1.0. How an area is filled: solid (the default when absent) or hatch, diagonal lines in fillColor and fillOpacity with the rest of the area transparent. Applies to Polygon, Circle, Ellipse, Corridor and ArcBand; elsewhere valid and not drawn.

arrowhead.description: Data model 1.1.0. none (the default when absent) or end: an arrowhead at a LineString's last point, along its last segment, in strokeColor. Elsewhere valid and not drawn.

pointMarkers.description: Data model 1.1.0. none (the default when absent) or circle: a small filled circle at every point of a LineString, in strokeColor. Elsewhere valid and not drawn.

properties.description: Core descriptive properties. Plugin-specific data belongs in extensions.
